senses.gloss:
टिप् {c10c} P. (टेपयति) To direct,
throw, cast.

टिप्पणी(नी) A gloss, a
comment; sometimes used in the sense
of ‘a gloss on a gloss’; as Kaiyaṭa's
commentary on the Mahābhāṣya,
or Nāgojībhaṭṭa's gloss on Kaiyaṭa's
gloss.

टिप्पणी(नी) A gloss, a
comment; sometimes used in the sense
of ‘a gloss on a gloss’; as Kaiyaṭa's
commentary on the Mahābhāṣya,
or Nāgojībhaṭṭa's gloss on Kaiyaṭa's
gloss.
